entities.name: Meditation Plane Breach
entities.description: A 4564 AR confrontation that freed Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: Plane where Ugin and Bolas were imprisoned.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon imprisoned on the Meditation Plane who escaped.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon who returned to Tarkir to end the dragonstorm outbreak.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who tried to alter history; he shattered and reformed as the plane's custodian.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who investigated the dragonstorms and revealed Bolas's name.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Investigated with Elspeth and revealed the Realm's true form.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Entered with Jace and tried to intervene.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: Creature with innate knowledge of Omenpaths.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Performed a corrupted Stormnexus Ritual; defeated by Ugin.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: Performed the corrupted ritual with Sarkhan.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane connected by Omenpath to the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Ugin's Spirit-Gem
entities.description: Stolen by Jace for his spell.

events.summary: Elspeth and Narset found an ancient temple holding the Omenpath to the Meditation Plane.
events.quote: they crossed the Stormplains and located an ancient temple containing the Omenpath

events.summary: In the Meditation Plane they met Jace and Loot, and found Ugin and the nameless dragon who had been Nicol Bolas; Elspeth inadvertently revealed his name.
events.quote: she inadvertently revealed his name to him

events.summary: Jace stole Ugin's Spirit-Gem and cast a spell to undo the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Jace stole Ugin's Spirit-Gem and began casting a complex spell

events.summary: The spell collapsed, erasing everything in its path, including Jace, who shattered like glass.
events.quote: including Jace, who shattered like glass

events.summary: Bolas overpowered Ugin and escaped into the Multiverse.
events.quote: Bolas overpowered Ugin and escaped into the Multiverse.

events.summary: Ugin defeated Sarkhan with ghostfire on Tarkir, ending the dragonstorm outbreak.
events.quote: Ugin swiftly defeated Sarkhan with ghostfire

events.summary: A reflected silhouette of a blue-cloaked mage appeared, a sign Jace had reformed as the plane's custodian.
events.quote: a sign that Jace had reformed as the plane's custodian

relations.quote: both bound in an eternal lockdown
Elspeth Tirel traveled to Tarkir and joined Narset in investigating.
